description: Defines functions and operator overloads related to media codecs, metadata, and stream info in the starboard namespace.

methods.name: GetMediaAudioCodecName
methods.description: Returns the name of the given audio codec.

methods.name: GetMediaVideoCodecName
methods.description: Returns the name of the given video codec.

methods.name: GetMediaAudioConnectorName
methods.description: Returns the name of the given audio connector.

methods.name: GetMediaPrimaryIdName
methods.description: Returns the name of the given primary ID.

methods.name: GetMediaTransferIdName
methods.description: Returns the name of the given transfer ID.

methods.name: GetMediaMatrixIdName
methods.description: Returns the name of the given matrix ID.

methods.name: GetMediaRangeIdName
methods.description: Returns the name of the given range ID.

methods.name: GetMediaAudioSampleTypeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the given audio sample type.

methods.name: GetMediaAudioStorageTypeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the given audio storage type.

methods.name: ParseVideoCodec
methods.description: Parses a video codec string into its components, returning true if well-formed.
